stress.the_gap: entry_conditions made four comparisons and returned a bool; the values were computed by peer_features, the thresholds were named in StressParams, both sat at the call site, and only the JOIN between them was thrown away - while the slot one frame up wrote not_exposed_by_sleeve into its own record

refactors.what: entry_checks() states the four comparisons AS DATA; entry_conditions became all() over it
refactors.why_not_a_second_function: a breakdown beside the original would be two statements of one rule - the drift this repo has paid for

refactors.what: basket_state() is detect_entry_for_slot's own opening, extracted
refactors.why: it computed the contexts and features and discarded them on the way to return []

proof_no_decision_moved.why_215_matters: an all-empty baseline would have proved nothing, and the first 40-day sample WAS all-empty; the sweep was widened until it contained 97 days the basket genuinely set up on

what_a_no_signal_slot_can_now_say.reading: the basket was fully bearish on breadth and gapped UP half a percent - a market answer, not a data answer

recorded.label: Calm

recorded.agreement_measured: 8/8 recent days, and flagged when it is not

regime.why_no_threshold: Viterbi picks the most likely PATH; nothing is compared against a constant, so there is no cut to be near, and a distance-to-threshold display would describe a decision procedure the model does not use
regime.what_stands_in_its_place: the lead over the runner-up state - a real number, named as a margin, never as a threshold distance
regime.proof_pinned_by_test: a test reads raits/hmm/engine.py and asserts predict_current contains no threshold
regime.still_recorded_not_computed_per_request: the 8.54s reason from 5ZZL holds; a test pins that label_regimes appears nowhere in the reader

measured.MNKD: 270 of the last 500 bars, mean 2.5 - a genuinely thin instrument

volume.rendered: a pane inside the chart's EXISTING box, so adding it cannot move the panel
volume.why_four: a column of zeros and an absent column must not draw the same

roska4_stress.after: four rule values with thresholds, the first failing one as a chip, volume pane

not_done_with_reasons.from_source: the detector returns SwingSetup(entry, stop, daily_atr, regime) when a setup exists and None when it does not
not_done_with_reasons.consequence: entry and stop ARE published on a signal day; on a quiet day the entry level is produced by a per-bar signal function inside a validated core strategy, not by a comparison against a standing level
not_done_with_reasons.why_not_faked: publishing a distance to entry would mean forming an entry the detector never formed

not_done_with_reasons.from_source: entry_conditions already returns a dict of its own values, so the raw material is there
not_done_with_reasons.why_not_wired: the live path reaches it through the DECIDE/OBSERVE contract, and the DECIDE half must not be shown values the OBSERVE half produces; wiring it without honouring that split would put a 10:00 reference price on a 09:32 decision
not_done_with_reasons.decision: left unwired rather than wired wrongly

not_done_with_reasons.why: persisting it belongs with a change to the slot's own write path, which touches the decision path and did not belong in a stage whose contract was change-no-decision
